_synthetic: Made up, shaped like what a sender's client is delivered when a tenant's policy blocks its 1:1 message with a file of a type the tenant doesn't permit, as a user's own debug log recorded it (structure only, read locally, nothing copied: every id, name, text, link and time here is made up). 'sent' is the message as sent and read back; 'copy' the NewMessage of the service's copy in the account's stream 48:generic (a new clientmessageid, the original HTML and files, threadtype streamofgeneric, no reference to the original); 'stream' the ConversationUpdate of 48:generic before it; 'blocked' the MessageUpdate of the original (empty content, no files, properties.policyViolation naming the copy by genericStreamItemId, edittime equal to its version); 'blocked_atp' the later one adding properties.atp. <guid:a>, <guid:b> are lab accounts' object ids, <region> the chat service's region; tests fill them in. See docs/protocol/chat.md, Messages a policy blocked.
